steps.description: Navigate to SpecterX
Fill email
Fill password
Click Sign In
Wait for My Files
Click the Share files button on the My Files page (article Step 1: Open the Share files dialog)

screenshot.focus: My Files page with the Share files button highlighted in the top area

steps.verify: The Share files dialog begins to open

steps.description: Wait for the Share files dialog to be fully open

screenshot.focus: Share files dialog with the upload area visible

steps.verify: The Share files dialog is open and the upload drop zone is visible

steps.description: Upload test-document.pdf using the file input in the Share files dialog (article Step 2: Upload your file)

screenshot.focus: test-document.pdf uploading in the dialog with a progress bar visible

steps.verify: test-document.pdf appears in the upload area with an upload progress indicator

steps.description: Wait for test-document.pdf to finish uploading

screenshot.focus: test-document.pdf showing as fully uploaded in the Share files dialog with no active progress bar

steps.verify: test-document.pdf is shown as uploaded with no active progress indicator

steps.description: Type a recipient email address in the Add recipients field (article Step 3: Add a recipient)

screenshot.focus: Add recipients field with the email address typed, before pressing Enter

steps.verify: The recipient email address is visible in the Add recipients field

steps.description: Press Enter to confirm and add the recipient to the list

screenshot.focus: Recipient email appearing as a chip or row in the recipients list inside the Share files dialog

steps.verify: The recipient email address appears as a chip or row in the recipients list

steps.description: Click the permission dropdown next to the recipient to open it (article Step 4: Set recipient permission level)

screenshot.focus: Permission dropdown open next to the recipient's email showing Viewer, Contributor, and Co-Owner options with Viewer highlighted

steps.verify: The permission dropdown is open showing Viewer, Contributor, and Co-Owner options

steps.description: Select Viewer from the permission dropdown

screenshot.focus: Viewer selected as the permission level next to the recipient's email

steps.verify: Viewer is selected as the permission level for the recipient

steps.description: Click the security policy dropdown to open it (article Step 5: Select a security policy)

screenshot.focus: Policy dropdown open in the Share files dialog showing available security policy names

steps.verify: The policy dropdown is open with a list of available security policies

steps.description: Select the Standard security policy from the dropdown

screenshot.focus: A security policy selected and displayed in the policy field of the Share files dialog

steps.verify: A security policy is selected and visible in the policy field

steps.description: Click the Share button to create the protected link and send notification emails (article Step 7: Complete the share)

screenshot.focus: Share files dialog with all fields filled — file, recipient, policy — and the Share button highlighted

steps.verify: The share request is submitted and SpecterX is processing the protected link creation

steps.description: Wait for the share confirmation screen showing the Copy link button

screenshot.focus: Share confirmation screen displaying the protected link and the Copy link button

steps.verify: The share confirmation screen is visible with the protected link and the Copy link button

steps.description: Click Copy link to copy the protected link to the clipboard (article Step 8: Copy the protected link)

screenshot.focus: Confirmation toast or message indicating the protected link was copied to clipboard

steps.verify: A confirmation toast or message indicates the protected link was copied to the clipboard

steps.description: Close the Share files confirmation and return to My Files
Wait for the My Files page to be visible after closing the dialog

screenshot.focus: My Files page with test-document.pdf listed, showing the share icon next to it

steps.verify: The My Files page is visible and test-document.pdf appears in the file list

steps.description: Click the share icon next to test-document.pdf to open the Share & Permissions Drawer (article: After you share section)

screenshot.focus: Share icon highlighted next to test-document.pdf in the My Files list

steps.verify: The Share & Permissions Drawer begins to open on the right side of the page

steps.description: Verify the Share & Permissions Drawer shows the recipient, permission level, and policy

screenshot.focus: Share & Permissions Drawer open on the right, showing the recipient list with permission dropdowns and the Parent policy dropdown at the top

steps.verify: The Share & Permissions Drawer is open and lists the recipient with their Viewer permission level and the applied security policy in the Parent policy dropdown

postconditions.description: Delete test-document.pdf from SpecterX to leave the tenant clean
